description: Quick personality micro-query: single_psych_dimension — single data point, lightweight, fast personality data

_signals.x_guidance: 3 products, pick what you need: KYH (personality analysis — start with /api/kyh/mbti for typing or /api/kyh/portrait for full profile), BLAH (communication coaching — /api/blah/adapt for tone, /api/blah/respond for reply drafts), KYB (sales intelligence — /api/kyb/profile for buyer type, /api/kyb/pitch for personalized pitch). Most agents need just 1-3 endpoints. Use /api/kyh/convergence ($5) only after running 2+ individual frameworks.
